name: How long does interior finishing typically take for a standard room remodel?

mainEntity.name: How long does interior finishing typically take for a standard room remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of interior finishing for a standard room remodel varies significantly based on the room's size, the scope of work, and material choices. A typical bathroom or kitchen remodel might see the finishing phase take anywhere from 2 to 6 weeks. This timeline includes tasks like drywall installation and finishing, painting, flooring installation, cabinet and countertop fitting, and fixture installation. Complex designs, custom elements, or material lead times can extend this schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior finishing for a standard room remodel can take 2 to 6 weeks, depending on room size, project scope, and material selections.
